full_prompt_en: A sunlit oil painting shows a wide sandy beach with a faded pink umbrella standing near the center. Its broad canopy occupies the upper middle, catching pale white highlights on the top and throwing a deep blue shadow across the sand below. A single folding chair sits just to the right of the pole, where a relaxed beachgoer appears as a few warm, sketchy strokes. Farther back, small figures wade and stand at the waterline, their bodies indicated with quick dark accents and touches of coral or white. The sea forms a steady cobalt band across the middle, broken by a narrow line of foamy surf and shimmering reflections on wet sand. Above it, clear saturated blue sky takes up nearly half the frame without clouds or distraction. The composition feels open and spacious despite the group of people, because the large fields of sky, water, and sand remain simple. Brushwork is visible in the umbrella, surf, and beach surface: short broken marks and a slightly grainy weave of color suggest heat and glare. The nearest shadows are cool blue, sharply contrasting with the warm cream and blush tones of the sand. Light comes from high overhead and slightly left, bleaching the top of the umbrella and softening distant outlines. The whole frame holds the easy rhythm of a bright seaside afternoon through open color, small human movement, and crisp sun-shadow contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅阳光充足的油画描绘宽阔沙滩，中央附近立着一把褪色粉红遮阳伞。宽大的伞面占据上方中部，顶部接住浅白高光，在下方沙面投出深蓝色阴影。一把折叠椅位于伞杆右侧，椅边一位放松的游客由少数暖色草图式笔触暗示。更远处，小小人影在水线附近涉水或站立，身体由迅疾的深色重点与珊瑚色、白色点染概括。海面在中部形成稳定的钴蓝色条带，被狭窄的浪花线和湿沙上闪动的倒影打断。其上，清澈而饱和的蓝天占据近半画幅，没有云或其他干扰。尽管有人群，构图仍开阔而宽敞，因为天空、海水和沙地的大块色域保持简洁。伞面、浪花与沙滩表面都能看见笔触：短而断续的笔迹和略带颗粒的色彩交织，暗示炎热和眩光。最近处的阴影是冷蓝色，与沙子的暖奶油色和浅粉色形成鲜明对比。光从高处略偏左照下，漂白伞顶，也柔化远处轮廓。整幅画通过开放色彩、细小人群运动和清晰的阳光阴影对比，保留明亮海滨午后的轻松节奏。
style_prompt_en: The oil image is organized into generous horizontal bands of saturated sky blue, deeper cobalt, pale blush-cream, and cool reflective blue. One broad warm accent interrupts the open upper field and casts a concentrated dark shadow into the lower area. Distant details are reduced to tiny broken marks, leaving color areas spacious and calm. Short, visible brushstrokes stipple the transitional line between land and water; a slightly grainy paint weave gives the luminous flats a tactile surface. High sunlight bleaches selected upper edges and makes cool shadows appear crisp against warm ground. The composition balances a large central canopy-like shape with a few scattered small strokes and a long uninterrupted horizon. Colors remain bright but natural, with little atmospheric haze. The whole frame feels breezy and unhurried through open space, direct light, and economical human-scale accents.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅油画图像由宽裕的水平色带组织起来：饱和天蓝、更深的钴蓝、浅粉奶油色和冷调反光蓝。一处宽大的暖色重点打断开放的上方色域，并向下方投出集中的深影。远处细节缩为小小断续笔迹，让大面积色彩保持宽敞平静。短促而可见的笔触点在陆地与水的过渡线上；略带颗粒的颜料交织，让发亮的平涂区域也有可触表面。高处日光漂白部分上缘，使冷色阴影在暖地面前格外清晰。构图以中央宽大的伞盖般形状，平衡零散小笔迹和一条漫长不中断的地平线。颜色明亮却自然，少有大气雾霾。整幅画借助开放空间、直接光线和节省的人类尺度重点，显得轻快而从容。
theme_en: A pink umbrella on a sunlit beach
theme_zh: 晴朗海滩上的粉色遮阳伞
name: Jan Matson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
